c: Take Us Away is summoned by flipping over levers found near the platform above the train track or on the walkway below, in the

stage. After a lever has been flipped, a train arrives from the left side of the screen, followed by train cars, which alternate between a coal car and a tank car. All enemies that collide with the train receive 200 damage, which scales with
increases the total number of train cars by 1 for each Amount stat. Additional
will not increase the size of the cars, but having decreased Area will reduce the hitbox size of the train cars.
affects how fast the train moves.

affects how long it would take before a train cart despawns once it is off-screen; having very low Duration may cause the summoned train cars to despawn off-screen before they even reach the player's view.
Additionally, Take Us Away receives +0.1, +0.4, and +1 bonus flat damage per 1% of Area, Speed, and Duration respectively.
Full image sprite of Take Us Away
Take Us Away despawns after a while once it leaves the player's screen, but won't disappear regardless of its duration as long as it is within view. With high enough
, achievable with Golden Eggs or characters with infinitely-increasing MoveSpeed stat, the player can catch up with the movement of Take Us Away, making it persist indefinitely.

The name for Take Us Away may be based on a short conversation in Final Fantasy VIII, where party member Selphie can sing a short song while on a train ride: "Train, train, take us away~/Take us away, far away~/To the future we will go~/Where it leads no one knows~"
